entries.title: The message box's hint writes a plain letter key in lower case
entries.body: When something else has your keyboard, the empty message box now says "press i to write a message" for the Vim keys, instead of a capital I that looked like it needed Shift. A letter you press with no other key reads in lower case there, such as the m in ⌃X m for the Emacs keys.

picture.alt: The empty message box with a paperclip at its left and the hint "press i to write a message" in its middle
